bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new facility for the Power of People Leadership Institute.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; POWER OF PEOPLE LEADERSHIP INSTITUTE. +]

[+$2,850,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Power of People Leadership Institute, to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip the renovation of a blighted warehouse property in North Minneapolis, into a facility providing programming, employment training, physical and mental health wellness services as well as providing space as a small business incubator. The new facility will also provide administrative and office space for the organization. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new facility for the Power of People Leadership Institute.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; POWER OF PEOPLE LEADERSHIP INSTITUTE.

$2,850,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Power of People Leadership Institute, to predesign, design, construct, furnish, and equip the renovation of a blighted warehouse property in North Minneapolis, into a facility providing programming, employment training, physical and mental health wellness services as well as providing space as a small business incubator. The new facility will also provide administrative and office space for the organization. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
